description:
Add Beadwork goal record and reject supervisor config, without deleting WorkerRuntime types yet (orchestrator.ts still exists until delete-runtime).

## Background

`/bw run` currently stores SessionRunOptions and a polling supervisor. Replace with Goal `{ goalId, scopeIds (exactly one epic in V1), reviewPolicy, startedAt }` and `run` = standing appendix + injected prompt, not a loop.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/types.ts` (add Goal; keep old worker types until delete-runtime)
- `src/config.ts`
- `src/session-state.ts`
- tests

## Reject (actionable, aggregated; refuse goal-mode start)

JSON families:

- all `tmux.*`
- all `worktrees.*`
- all `landing.*` including `validateCommands` (not migrated into a new gate)
- all `supervisor.*`
- `workerExecution.*`
- `run.defaultWorkers`, `run.defaultUntil`, `run.defaultMaxCycles`, `run.pollIntervalMs`
- `storage.workerRegistryFile`, `storage.runtimeDir`

Corresponding env vars (reject, do not ignore):

- `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_REGISTRY_FILE`, `PI_BEADWORK_RUNTIME_DIR`
- `PI_BEADWORK_TMUX_SESSION_NAME`, `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_COMMAND`, `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_PROVIDER`, `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_MODEL`
- `PI_BEADWORK_WORKTREE_BASE_DIR`
- `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_EXECUTION_MODE`, `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_MAX_LIFETIME`, `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_ALLOW_DETACHED_HEAD`
- `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_REVIEW_ENABLED`, `PI_BEADWORK_WORKER_SELF_REVIEW_ENABLED`
- `PI_BEADWORK_DEFAULT_WORKERS`, `PI_BEADWORK_DEFAULT_MAX_CYCLES`, `PI_BEADWORK_POLL_INTERVAL_MS`
- `PI_BEADWORK_VALIDATE_TIMEOUT_MS`, `PI_BEADWORK_MAX_REBASE_ATTEMPTS`, `PI_BEADWORK_LANDING_POLICY`
- `PI_BEADWORK_SUPERVISOR_POLL_INTERVAL_MS`

## Retain

- `PI_BEADWORK_SHOW_INACTIVE_STATUS` / `ui.showInactiveStatus`
- `PI_BEADWORK_SESSION_STATE_DIR` / `storage.sessionStateDir` (cache only)
- review policy `ticket | scope | none` and reviewer role/model **only** if mapping from old review settings is unambiguous display/prompt config — never a validation runner, never silent backend selection

Do not map `landing.review` / worker-review onto a beadwork command runner. Do not migrate `landing.validateCommands`.

## Behavior

- Persisted `mode: "run"` after `/new` or process death is **interrupted**: no auto-inject, no live workers. User `/bw run` again. Stop persisting `trackedWorkerIds` / `runOptions`.

## Success criteria

- Config with tmux.sessionName fails goal-mode start with aggregated errors.
- Clean config loads; Goal round-trips; rehydrated run is not live.
- WorkerRuntime types still compile.

## Test plan

- Unit: each removed JSON family and env var listed above.
- Unit: retained keys still load.
- Unit: interrupted run flag.
- Log: rejected key names.

## Considerations

Owns types.ts/config.ts/session-state.ts. Do not rewrite prompt.ts or actions/run.ts.

comments.text: Keep WorkerRuntime/tmux types until delete-runtime so orchestrator.ts still typechecks. Reject supervisor keys at load for goal mode. Persisted run is interrupted, never auto-inject.

title: Add goal record, interrupted run, and reject supervisor config
